pattern: A focusable, named scroll region (role=region) containing the code as text; toolbar actions are native toggle and push buttons.

roles.role: region (named by label, described by the line count and language or the diff counts)

aria.value: visually hidden summary: '120 lines, TypeScript' or '3 added, 2 removed, JSON'

aria.element: line numbers, diff markers, side-by-side headings
aria.value: true (the line text carries the meaning)

keyboard.action: Toolbar buttons, then the code region.

keyboard.key: Arrow keys / Page Up / Page Down / Home / End
keyboard.action: Scroll the code (native scrolling of the focused region).
Toggle wrapping, switch the diff mode, or copy.

focus: The region is focusable (tabindex=0) so keyboard users can scroll it; toggling options keeps focus on the button.
notes: Added and removed lines start with visually hidden 'Added:' and 'Removed:' text, and highlighted lines with 'Highlighted:', so changes are not conveyed by color alone.
Copy results and option changes are announced in a polite live region; a refused clipboard is announced assertively.
Line numbers are hidden from assistive technology and excluded from text selection.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
In virtualized files, only the rows in view are in the accessibility tree; screen-reader users read them by scrolling the region.
